_comment: FY2025 grounded actuals (bank schema). Source: ADCB FY2025 results (adcb.com / ADX), Jan 2026, confirmed by TradeArabia / AGBI / earnings call. Net profit after tax AED 11.445bn (+22% YoY; profit-before-tax AED 12.843bn +21%, 18 consecutive quarters of PBT growth). NII AED 12.0bn (+9%); operating income +14%; cost-income 28.2% (record low). Net loans AED 406bn (+16%); customer deposits AED 500bn (+19%); total assets AED 774bn (+19%). ROE 15.3%; CET1 13.82%; LCR 124.2%. Recommended cash dividend 63 fils/sh (AED 4.985bn, ~44% payout). EPS and non-interest-income omitted (full-year ordinary EPS / FY non-interest split not cleanly disclosed in the release).
